name: Goodwife Perl
title: Orchardist
examine: Twigs in her braid and a windfall bruise on one knuckle that she blames, with great specificity, on a cow.
lines: My husband planted the oldest oak. I planted the rest around him, so he'd have company.
The pasture cows have declared war on my windfalls. I have taken it to the moot twice. The cows have taken it to the fence. The cows are winning.
An orchard is patience you can eat. Sit in the shade a while.
